moments.title: When you'll need it
moments.text: The papers are always asked for at the worst moment. Now they're always in your pocket.
moments.bankText: Aadhaar and PAN ready to show or send, without hunting through the cupboard.
moments.schoolText: Birth certificate, marksheets and photos for the forms — made smaller with Resize & compress.
moments.hospitalText: Health insurance card and reports in hand, even when someone else is at the hospital.
moments.travelText: Passport, visa and tickets on your phone, and a copy you can share with family back home.
moments.farText: Mummy and Papa add a photo, you open it from another city. No more "send it on WhatsApp again".
moments.propertyText: Sale deeds, policies and renewal dates in one place, for the day the family needs them.

why.title: Made for the whole family
why.text: Simple enough for parents, safe enough for your most important papers.
why.easyText: Big buttons, plain words and the whole app in Hindi. Add a document in three taps.
why.privateText: Files and passwords are stored encrypted. Only the people in your family can see them.
why.shareText: Send a document on WhatsApp with a link that switches off by itself. Passwords and notes are never shared.
why.familyText: Invite family members and choose who can only look and who can add or change things.
why.scanText: Take a photo of a paper: the edges are cut neatly and the words are read, so you can search them later.
why.findText: Search by name, note or the words inside a document. No more digging through WhatsApp chats.

tour.title: Take a look inside
tour.text: This is what your family sees on the phone.
tour.homeText: The family's folders and how much is saved, on one screen.
tour.docText: Photos of every page, with notes like "Keep a copy for bank KYC".
tour.passwordText: PINs stay hidden until you tap the eye. Copy with one tap.
tour.hindiText: Tap हिन्दी at the top and the whole app switches.

safety.title: How we keep it safe
safety.text: Your documents are your family's most private papers. This is how Family Vault protects them.
safety.encryptText: Every file and saved password is locked with AES-256 encryption before it is stored.
safety.loginText: It is stored scrambled, never as you typed it. Too many wrong tries are blocked.
safety.idleText: Left the app open? It signs you out after an hour without use.
safety.everywhereTitle: Lost a phone? You stay in control
safety.everywhereText: Change your password and every other phone and computer is signed out.
safety.linksText: Shared links stop working by themselves. Passwords and notes are never shared.
safety.activityText: Activity shows who added, opened or shared each document.

share.title: Need to send a document? Share it safely
share.text: The bank, school or a relative needs a copy? Create a link and send it on WhatsApp.
share.point1: The link switches off by itself after 12 hours, 1 day or 7 days
share.point2: Switch it off yourself at any time
share.point3: See when the link was opened
share.shot: Sharing a car insurance document with a link that lasts 12 hours

steps.title: Start in three easy steps
steps.oneText: Sign up with Google or your email and give your family a name.
steps.twoText: Take a photo, pick from your gallery or add a PDF. Put it in a folder.
steps.threeText: Send an invite on WhatsApp so everyone has the papers when they need them.

extra.title: And a few more helpful things
extra.bin: Deleted something by mistake? Bring it back from the Bin.
extra.resize: Make a photo smaller for online forms with Resize & compress.
extra.activity: See who added, opened or shared what in Activity.

faq.title: Common questions
faq.freeA: Yes. Family Vault is completely free for every family. There is no card to add and no hidden charge.
faq.safeA: Yes. Your files and passwords are stored encrypted, and only the members of your family can see them. When you share a document, the link switches off by itself, and passwords and notes are never shared.
faq.parentsA: Yes. Family Vault is made to be simple, with big buttons and plain words. It works fully in Hindi, and parents can add a document by just taking a photo.
faq.hindiQ: Can I use it in Hindi?
faq.hindiA: Yes. Every screen is available in English and हिन्दी. Each person can pick their own language with one tap.
faq.devicesQ: Does it work on a phone and a computer?
faq.devicesA: Yes. It works in the browser on any phone, tablet or computer, and you can add it to your phone's home screen like an app.
faq.familyA: Only the people you invite to your family. You choose who can only look and who can add or change things, and you can remove anyone at any time.
faq.deleteQ: What if I delete something by mistake?
faq.deleteA: Deleted documents go to the Bin first, so you can bring them back.
